title: Private open space per apartment: minimum dimension (Table 1.1a), R10 to R25
text: Primary garden area. C1.1.1 A minimum of one private open space area is provided for the exclusive use of each dwelling, in accordance with Table 1.1a. Table 1.1a Primary garden area provisions. Minimum private open space dimension: Studio/1 bedroom 2m; 2 bedrooms, 3 or more bedrooms 2.4m; Ground floor dwelling 3m.

replaces.note: 2.4 m for all sizes -> 2 m / 2.4 m / 3 m by dwelling size

notes: from: ch3 C1.1.1-r1. diverges: dimension by apartment size (table-1.1a-dim) in place of the 4 m OLA dimension. Register C4P1-006 (mixed): current Part B 5.3.1 C1.2 is one balcony of 10 m2 / 2.4 m for every multiple dwelling; studio/1 bed is relaxed to 8 m2 / 2 m, 3+ bed tightened to 12 m2, ground floor 15 m2 / 3 m is new. The Table of Changes says OLA controls continue at R25 and below with minimum size unchanged, which the Chapter 4 Part 1 text does not do (verify). Fact describes the least compliant apartment against Table 1.1a (p9) and its size category (studio_1bed, 2bed, 3bed_plus, ground_floor; proposed fact). Service areas (bin storage, clothes drying, air conditioning units and the like) are excluded from the POS area. Table 1.1a is titled 'Primary garden area provisions', a misnomer for apartments (C4P1-004, C4P1-005).

verified.note: Page applies Table 1.1a to all apartments with no coding split; the Table of Changes statement that OLA controls continue at R25 and below is not reflected on p9.
